tools.name: get_check_results
tools.description: Gets the results of a check that was still running, by its check_id. Waits up to 40 seconds for it to finish.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_me_the_full_report · Public sink: email_me_the_full_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_me_the_full_report · Public sink: email_me_the_full_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
